# UnderStack

UnderStack is a software company in Aarhus, Denmark. It builds custom software, web platforms, AI-enabled workflows, app products and restaurant technology for companies in Denmark and Europe.

## Public company and service pages

- [Home (English)](https://understack.dk/en/): company overview and services
- [Home (Danish)](https://understack.dk/dk/): company overview and services
- [Web development](https://understack.dk/en/web-development): websites and web platforms
- [Software development](https://understack.dk/en/software-development): custom business software
- [AI development](https://understack.dk/en/ai-development): applied AI solutions and workflows
- [Restaurant software](https://understack.dk/en/restaurant-software): operations software for restaurants
- [For You](https://understack.dk/en/for-you): websites and small digital projects
